name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 21 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 21 hours starting 2026-01-21, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.77 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
